params.price_note: CFFEX fields: settle=今结算, close=今收盘; no settlement algorithm is inferred.
params.rate_convention: r(tau)=ln(1+L/100*tau*365/360)/tau from SHIBOR ACT/360 simple; linear in T, flat outside pillars
params.forward_estimator: volume-weighted mean of F_K=K+(C-P)/DF within |ln(F_K/median F_K)|<=0.05

svi_bounds.justification: eta_min=0.01 lies below the observed strike spacing; eta_max=1.0 covers wide shallow smiles without the legacy 2.0 extreme.

params.svi_weights: equal weights on OTM liquid quotes

filter_removals.note: No bid-ask snapshot is available; volume >= min_volume stands in for spread/liquidity.

repricing.note: Both bases use the common strikes with a liquid OTM quote and a liquid call. otm uses the traded OTM option (put below F, call at/above F); calls uses the traded call only. No synthetic call is constructed. Per fit: max and median relative repricing error; across fits: median and p95 of those statistics.

butterfly.note: Primary test uses correct Gatheral g incl. w''/2; printed formula omits w''/2.

calendar.term_structure: linear interpolation in total variance w at fixed k

forward_check.note: IF close/settle are the CFFEX fields 今收盘 and 今结算; matched by the IO expiry year-month. Basis is annualized r - ln(IF/S0)/T. implied_q_median/q_minus_if_basis_* use exactly the matched pairs; implied_q_all_median is shown for contrast.

svi_bounds.note: Legacy bounds are [1e-6, 2.0]; new bounds are [eta_min, eta_max]. RMSE is in total variance w on each fit's liquid OTM strike set.

rates.convention: simple ACT/360 SHIBOR converted to continuous zero rate on ACT/365 T
